title: Gesture-controlled wheelchair with hurdle detection
highlights: Accelerometer X on PA1 and Y on PA2 go through the ADC; threshold bands map to forward, back, left, right and stop.
Motor driver on PORTB bits 4-7; a 16x2 LCD on PORTC shows the live readings.
An IR obstacle input on PORTD stops the chair and backs it away.
summary: ATmega32 firmware that turns hand tilt into wheelchair motion. A two-axis MEMS accelerometer is read through the ADC, and an IR obstacle input overrides the motors.
